en: Light NY update (08:45 CT): starting from today's Saturday Nov 21 close plan, no re-derivation and no grading.

Right now ETH trades at 1,687.29 (-1.8% on 24h) and BTC at 60,310.76 (-1.67% on 24h): the 24h move cooled a lot versus the close (-8.07%/-5.51%).

Both zones per coin (the A+ buy at the POC/averages/VWAP cluster and the B sell at the range ceiling) broke under the size of the move: the first because price pierced its stop long before the rebound, the second because price blew straight through it on the way up. No mapped zone is in reach now: AVOID on both coins.
